messages:
jordyn_cs: Heads up — Clearway Logistics is onboarding two more warehouse teams (returns + QA) and asked to accelerate rollouts. They expect search + Q&A traffic and a big jump in embeddings. They're requesting 10 additional API keys and a rate-limit bump. Can we triage impact on quotas, cost, and any enablement needed? :eyes:
ev an_se: Quick q — do we have rough peak TPS and token sizes? Also are they using streaming responses or sync generation?
jordyn_cs: Mostly sync for search and embeddings; occasional streaming for guided QA. Numbers they gave: peak ~200 req/s across org, avg gen tokens ~40, embeddings currently 5k/day -> forecast 15-20k/day after rollout. Spikes concentrated 09:00-11:00 local.
maya_ae: They're asking whether Dedicated capacity makes sense vs Hosted. Legal also pinged about PII and retention — they want a clear guidance doc. Renewal conversation in 2 Qs so this is high signal for expansion but also an enablement + compliance touchpoint.
luke_sre: We can provision temporary quota increases. Proposal: soft increase per-key rps to 250 for 30 days while we observe. For long-term predictable throughput, recommend Dedicated capacity sizing — I can sketch numbers if you want. For Hosted, caching + prefix-KV and batching embeddings will reduce cost. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Suggestion: enable per-route burst window and add short TTL KV cache for repeated queries during peak. Example batch embedding call we recommend:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
{
  "model": "open-embed-1024",
  "inputs": [ ... up to 512 items ... ],
  "batch_config": { "max_batch_tokens": 8192 }
}
```
jordyn_cs: Perfect — can you generate a quick ops playbook (limits to request, caching config, and a KB for the customer) so AE can share? Maya, I'll schedule an enablement runbook call with Clearway next week.
maya_ae: Yes please. Also need an FAQ snippet on PII handling for Legal. Can we get SRE confirmation on retention + audit logs for their account (they're asking for 12 months)?
luke_sre: Retention default is 30 days for hosted. For accounts requesting 12mo audit logs we need an enterprise data retention add-on (Private or Dedicated with logging enabled). I can draft the compliance note. For now we can offer encrypted logs export to their S3 bucket as interim.
jordyn_cs: Noted. I'll include that in the deck. Regarding keys — can we pre-create the 10 keys so they can distribute to teams?
luke_sre: We can auto-generate keys from the console for them, but we should gate by soft quota and tag keys per team. I'll create a script for key creation + tagging.
maya_ae: Pricing sensitivity: customer asked for an estimate on monthly delta if they stay on Hosted at forecasted volume.
billing-bot: Estimated hosted delta: +$2.8k/mo (embeddings + search tokens) assuming current pricing and no batching. With batching + KV caching we project ~1.6k/mo.
jordyn_cs: Good to know — I'll push caching guidance during enablement. Can someone own the kick-off doc + runbook and share by EOD tomorrow?
ev an_se: I'll take the runbook (ops config + rate limits) and loop in SRE for the keys.
luke_sre: I'll draft the compliance note and key creation script.
maya_ae: I'll own the customer comms and pricing appendix. Schedule invite for kickoff: Wed 10am PT.
jordyn_cs: Great — thanks team. Tagging this as an expansion signal; will update account health dashboard after kickoff. :rocket:
